name: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin (Free)
description: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin is InclusionAI’s finance-enhanced MoE language model, combining 124 billion total parameters with approximately 5.1 billion active parameters for efficient financial reasoning. Its 256K context window, function calling, and support for complex, multi-step investment workflows make it ideal for financial research, analysis, long-horizon planning, and execution, while retaining strong capabilities in coding and mathematics.
